How Overdrive works
It talks to the Ally's firmware and the AMD driver directly, in place of Armoury Crate while you want it to.
1

Pick a mode

Silent, Balanced and Turbo each send their own watts, or set Manual limits yourself.

  • Silent 13 W, Balanced 17 W, Turbo 35 W
  • Manual: three limits from 5 to 50 W
2

Auto TDP

Watches the frame rate and trims the watts while the game keeps its pace:

  • Holds your FPS limit at the lowest watts
  • FPS limit off: drops only watts that add no frames
  • Never above the mode's own watts
3

Fans your way

A preset or your own 8-point curve, for the CPU and the GPU fan:

  • Armoury default, Recommended, Quiet, Cool
  • Drag points or use the D-pad
  • Never below a safe minimum
Safe by design Armoury Crate's services are recorded first and restored exactly; your settings come back after sleep and on start.
